title_en: 李效时 — 受贿、贪污案
keywords_en: Criminal; Accepting bribes; Embezzlement; Second instance; High People's Court; Beijing Municipality; State organ; Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery; Criminal Law of the PRC; Whether constitutes bribery crime; Whether constitutes embezzlement crime; Whether evidence is sufficient; Affirm the original judgment; Illegal fund-raising; Offering bribes
full_text_en:
Li Xiaoshi Bribery and Embezzlement Case

Defendant: Li Xiaoshi, male, 53 years old, formerly Deputy Director of the State Science and Technology Commission, arrested on June 5, 1993.

The Branch of the Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate instituted a public prosecution with the Beijing Intermediate People's Court against the defendant Li Xiaoshi for crimes of bribery, embezzlement, and holding a huge amount of property with unidentified sources.

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court, after trial, found the following facts:

During his tenure as Deputy Director of the State Science and Technology Commission, from June to July 1992, the defendant Li Xiaoshi made affirmative instructions and speeches regarding the expansion of illegal fundraising by Beijing Changcheng Mechanical and Electrical Science and Technology Industrial Company (hereinafter referred to as Beijing Changcheng Company). These instructions and speeches were later widely disseminated through news media by Shen Taifu (separately dealt with), President of Changcheng Company, and Sun Shuxing (separately dealt with), a reporter from the Science and Technology Daily, and played a certain role in the illegal fundraising activities of Beijing Changcheng Company. Therefore, on March 3, 1993, Shen Taifu attempted to bribe Li Xiaoshi with RMB 40,000, which Li did not accept. The next day, Sun Shuxing converted the RMB 40,000 in cash into a "Technology Development Contract" and a "Dividend Settlement Card" from Beijing Changcheng Company, delivered them to Li Xiaoshi's home, and telephoned Li to inform him of the situation. Li Xiaoshi kept the contract and dividend settlement card in his office for safekeeping. On April 4, 1993, after Shen Taifu's case came to light, Li Xiaoshi returned the contract and dividend settlement card to Sun Shuxing.

After the defendant Li Xiaoshi became acquainted with the Hong Kong businessmen Pan Kuntai and Liang Shaoyin (a married couple) in August 1990, he took advantage of his official position to provide assistance to the couple in their business operations, such as establishing companies and conducting business in China. In August 1991, Li Xiaoshi, because his son was going abroad, accepted HK$5,000 (equivalent to RMB 3,453.5) from Liang Shaoyin. In February 1993, before Li Xiaoshi went abroad for a visit, he accepted US$1,000 (equivalent to RMB 5,740.2) from Liang Shaoyin.

The defendant Li Xiaoshi, taking advantage of his official position, included the products of Beijing Tongli Refrigeration Equipment Company in the Torch Program of the State Science and Technology Commission, and provided assistance to that company's business activities. Consequently, in July 1992, Li Xiaoshi demanded and obtained from the company one Tongli brand KF-25G split-type air conditioner, valued at RMB 3,500.

When the defendant Li Xiaoshi served as the President of the Science and Technology Daily, from July to September 1990, during the process of arranging for the newspaper to publish a special edition article on "Prevention and Control of Geological Disasters," he took advantage of his position to unlawfully intercept and misappropriate for his own use the special edition publicity fee of RMB 90,000 paid by the On-site Command Headquarters for Prevention and Control of Geological Disasters at Lianzi Cliff and Huangla Stone of the Three Gorges on the Yangtze River.

The above facts are confirmed by evidence including witness testimony, the Technology Development Contract and Dividend Settlement Card, the seized air conditioner, and relevant documentary and physical evidence.

The Beijing Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant Li Xiaoshi, being a state functionary, took advantage of his position to accept bribes from others and demand property from others, and his conduct constituted the crime of bribery as stipulated in Article 4(1) of the Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Concerning the Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery (hereinafter referred to as the "Supplementary Provisions"). Li Xiaoshi, taking advantage of his position, embezzled public funds, and his conduct constituted the crime of embezzlement as stipulated in Article 1(1) of the Supplementary Provisions. The indictment charging Li Xiaoshi with the crime of holding a huge amount of property with unidentified sources was found to be unclear in facts and insufficient in evidence, and therefore not established. In light of the amount and circumstances of Li Xiaoshi's bribery, he should be punished in accordance with Article 5(1) of the Supplementary Provisions, applying Article 2 of the said Provisions. For Li Xiaoshi's crime of embezzlement, based on its circumstances, he should be punished in accordance with Article 2(1)(1) of the Supplementary Provisions, and a partial confiscation of his personal property should be imposed. Li Xiaoshi's illegal gains and the seized illicit goods, in accordance with Article 12 of the Supplementary Provisions, should be confiscated and recovered respectively. Li Xiaoshi committed multiple crimes, and in accordance with Article 64(1) of the Criminal Law of the PRC, concurrent punishment for multiple crimes should be imposed. For criminals who seriously undermine the socialist economic order, in accordance with Article 52 of the Criminal Law, deprivation of political rights may be imposed as a supplementary punishment.

Accordingly, on March 4, 1994, the Beijing Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

1. The defendant Li Xiaoshi is convicted of bribery and sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for 3 years and partial confiscation of personal property; convicted of embezzlement and sentenced to 7 years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for 1 year; the combined sentence is fixed at 20 years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for 4 years and partial confiscation of personal property.

2. The seized illicit money from the defendant Li Xiaoshi, RMB 20,000, HK$5,000, and US$1,000, is confiscated; one Tongli brand KF-25G split-type air conditioner is to be returned to Tongli Refrigeration Equipment Company.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Li Xiaoshi filed an appeal, raising the following grounds: (1) The RMB 20,000 special edition publicity fee was entirely used for the filming of the TV drama "No Gunshot on the Lake," and the first instance judgment's finding that the defendant "unlawfully intercepted and misappropriated for his own use" was inconsistent with the facts. (2) The first instance judgment's finding that the defendant accepted HK$5,000 and US$1,000 from Liang Shaoyin was insufficiently evidenced. (3) The air conditioner was borrowed by the defendant from Tongli Company, and the first instance judgment's finding that he demanded a bribe was insufficiently evidenced. (4) The first instance judgment's finding that the defendant secured benefits for Changcheng Company was without basis.

The Beijing High People's Court, upon trial, held that: The appellant Li Xiaoshi, being a state functionary, took advantage of his position to accept and demand bribes and embezzle public funds, and his conduct constituted the crimes of bribery and embezzlement respectively. Li Xiaoshi's appeal denying the interception of the RMB 20,000 special edition publicity fee paid to the Science and Technology Daily by the On-site Command Headquarters for Prevention and Control of Geological Disasters at Lianzi Cliff and Huangla Stone of the Three Gorges was, upon investigation, disproved by the certificate from the Finance Department of the Science and Technology Daily and the testimony of Sun Qiaosheng, Xi Dazhen, and Peng Qixiu, all of which are on record. Li Xiaoshi's appeal claim that the sum was used to pay for the filming of a TV drama was a personal act of Li Xiaoshi and not an official duty. Li Xiaoshi's appeal that the evidence regarding his acceptance of bribes from Liang Shaoyin and his demand for an air conditioner from Tongli Company was insufficient was, upon investigation, disproved by the testimony of bribe-giver Liang Shaoyin, Tongli Company manager Bai Yunan, and others, as well as physical and documentary evidence on record, which are reliable and sufficient. Li Xiaoshi's denial that he secured benefits for Changcheng Company was, upon investigation, disproved by Li Xiaoshi's speeches and instructions during his inspections of Beijing and Hainan Changcheng Company and witness testimony on record, which sufficiently demonstrate that Li Xiaoshi's conduct played a role in fueling the expansion of Changcheng Company's illegal fundraising. The aforementioned grounds of appeal raised by Li Xiaoshi are untenable and are not accepted. The first instance judgment, rendered based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of harm to society of Li Xiaoshi's crimes, was correct in conviction and application of law, appropriate in sentencing, and lawful in trial procedure, and should be affirmed. Accordingly, on April 11, 1994, the court, in accordance with Article 136(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, ruled as follows: The appeal of the appellant Li Xiaoshi is dismissed, and the original judgment is affirmed.
